smyx-family-conflict-aftercare-suggest-analysis 1.0.0

- Initial release of a smart aftercare skill for family conflict scenarios using fixed cameras and microphones in common areas.
- Detects intense disputes (loud arguments, door slams, aggressive gestures) in real time; prompts calming actions (soft music, caring messages) after a conflict and a calm period.
- Utilizes AI to analyze both audio and video cues, distinguishing conflict from normal activity and assessing severity.
- Provides non-intrusive support to de-escalate negative emotions and encourage recovery of communication post-conflict.
- Strict open-id acquisition and security, with clear data-use policies and emergency protocols for critical situations.
- Supports querying historical aftercare events and integrates with smart speakers or home-security systems for enhanced family care.
